name: Banbán
text: Banbán is a name from early Irish story, with the sense of little pig. He is often called Banbán the hospitable. He appears in the strange account of the death of the king Diarmait mac Cerbaill. His part in that story makes him a figure of note in the old sources.

attributes.attribute: appears in the death tale of Diarmait

okr.objective: Record Banbán and his place in Irish story.
